about: Which note rewrites loosen protection, as ONE rule both sides implement: src-tauri/src/note_protection.rs `loosened` and src/lib/protectionRule.ts `loosened` (review 2026-11-20: writers replaced a note's text and dropped `locked`, `secure` or `secureContext`). A rewrite may not turn off locked, secure or secureContext, gain local_ai_allowed, or newly allow an AI body edit. `notePaths` is the file-save lane's refusal (`is_note_path` / `isNotePath`). Both sides' tests run every case.
